description: Source code for CoAP link format handling in Zephyr OS, including functions for matching URIs and attributes, formatting resource descriptions, and handling CoAP block-wise transfers.

methods.name: append_u8
methods.description: Inline function to append a single byte to a CoAP packet.

methods.name: append_be16
methods.description: Inline function to append a 16-bit big-endian value to a CoAP packet.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Inline function to append a byte array to a CoAP packet.

methods.description: Function to match a URI against a resource path.
